name: nod-monorepo
description: Nod, a local-first meeting notetaker: desktop and mobile apps and their shared core
author: Dima Barabash

scripts.lint:fix: pnpm -r lint:fix && oxlint --fix scripts && oxfmt --write AGENTS.md README.md package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json .agents .claude .codex .github .vscode docs scripts
scripts.lint:root: oxlint scripts && oxfmt --check AGENTS.md README.md package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json .agents .claude .codex .github .vscode docs scripts && node scripts/check-no-type-assertions.ts scripts
